consumer: The craft-here salvage eligibility check that asks 'are >=20 scrap available within crafting reach to satisfy this objective?'
scope: The full crafting reachable inventory (avatar's person plus nearby map tiles, ground, containers, and adjacent vehicles within the crafting radius), not just on-person items
decisive_source: src/visitable.cpp::visitable<Character>::amount_of -- tallies only the Character's own carried inventory (plus bionic/pseudo-tool special cases) via amount_of_internal, so its reach is on-person only
divergence: Avatar carries 18 scrap and an adjacent crate within crafting reach holds 12 more; true reachable total 30 (>=20, should pass) but amount_of<Character> reports 18 and wrongly fails the objective
